label.zh: 美国联邦能源监管委员会冬季评估

title.en: A winter peak is not an annual bill
title.zh: 冬季峰值不是全年电费

summary.en: FERC staff expect sufficient resources this winter under normal conditions. They cite a NERC projection of about 245 GW of additional North American winter peak demand over the next decade, driven mostly by large loads, chiefly data centres.
summary.zh: 委员会工作人员预计，今冬在正常条件下电力资源充足。评估援引北美电力可靠性公司的预测：未来十年北美冬季峰值需求将增加约 245 吉瓦，增长主要来自大型用电负荷，尤其是数据中心。

takeaway.en: The projection concerns power at peak times, not annual energy consumed or a confirmed shortage.
takeaway.zh: 预测衡量的是高峰时段的功率，不是全年用电量，也不代表已经出现缺电。

title.zh: 防护测试发现薄弱之处

summary.en: Anthropic says its automated evaluations uncovered weaknesses in its safeguards.
summary.zh: Anthropic 表示，其自动化评估发现了自身防护措施中的弱点。

takeaway.en: A developer describing what its tests caught is not an independent assessment of what they missed.
takeaway.zh: 开发者披露了测试发现的问题；这不等于有人独立评估过漏检的问题。

label.zh: 美国消费者金融保护局公告

summary.en: The CFPB identifies overlapping drivers of complaint growth, including AI tools acting as agents and business intermediaries.
summary.zh: 美国消费者金融保护局指出，投诉增长有多种相互重叠的原因，包括代为办事的 AI 工具以及商业中介。

takeaway.en: Complaint volume alone tells us neither how many submissions involved AI nor which complaints have merit.
takeaway.zh: 仅凭投诉总量，既不能判断多少投诉涉及 AI，也不能判断哪些投诉有理有据。

label.zh: 《2026 国际人工智能安全报告》

title.en: What a pre-release test cannot settle
title.zh: 上线前的测试不能说明什么

summary.en: The report distinguishes malicious use, malfunctions and systemic risks. It notes that pre-deployment evaluations do not reliably predict real-world utility or risk.
summary.zh: 报告区分了恶意使用、系统失灵和系统性风险，并指出部署前的评估不能可靠预测实际应用中的效用或风险。

takeaway.en: Ask where the system will be used before treating a test score as evidence that it belongs there.
takeaway.zh: 先问系统将在哪里使用，再判断测试分数能否支持在那里部署。

label.en: Final prospectus filed with the SEC
label.zh: 提交美国证交会的最终招股说明书

title.zh: 账目中的训练数据版权

summary.en: According to the filing, Anthropic accrued $1.5 billion in 2025 for the Bartz training-data copyright settlement. The court approved the settlement in July 2026.
summary.zh: 据文件披露，Anthropic 于 2025 年为 Bartz 训练数据版权案和解计提了 15 亿美元。法院于 2026 年 7 月批准和解。

takeaway.en: This is one example of the cost of a rights dispute. The filing describes an earlier settlement, not a new fine.
takeaway.zh: 这是版权争议成本的一个实例。文件披露的是此前的和解，并非新增罚款。

title.en: ALIGN studies control-accountability gaps in high-risk AI use
title.zh: ALIGN 研究高风险 AI 使用中的控制—问责缺口

summary.en: The ALIGN team published a method for spotting cases where the people expected to be accountable for an AI risk may not actually have enough control to manage it. The authors say they developed and evaluated the method, but the result is a governance tool, not evidence that deployed systems became safer.
summary.zh: ALIGN 团队发布了一种方法，用于识别“应承担 AI 风险问责的人，未必拥有足够控制权”这类情形。作者称已完成方法开发与评估，但这只是治理工具，并不等于已证明部署系统更安全。

takeaway.en: Useful for assigning responsibility, but it still needs real-world validation before anyone treats it as a safety fix.
takeaway.zh: 它对厘清责任有用，但在被当作安全修复方案之前，仍需要真实场景验证。

title.en: OpenAI describes a stricter evidence standard from training to deployment
title.zh: OpenAI 说明了从训练到部署的更严格证据标准

summary.en: OpenAI says it now requires stronger evidence of aligned behavior during training and uses written, evidence-backed safety arguments when deciding whether to proceed to deployment. This is a first-party description of process changes, not an independent test of whether those changes reduce risk in practice.
summary.zh: OpenAI 表示，其现在在训练阶段要求更强的对齐行为证据，并在是否进入部署时使用书面、以证据支撑的安全论证。这是公司对流程变化的自述，不是对这些变化是否能在实践中降低风险的独立检验。

takeaway.en: The signal is a tighter governance process; the open question is whether the process consistently catches dangerous gaps before release.
takeaway.zh: 可见信号是治理流程更严格；仍待验证的是，这套流程能否在发布前稳定识别出危险缺口。

label.en: OpenAI blog: Managing frontier AI risk
label.zh: OpenAI 博文：管理前沿 AI 风险

title.en: No Perfect Guardrail & No Perfect Guard: On the Decidability of Output Policies for Large Language Models
title.zh: 无完美护栏与无完美护栏：关于大语言模型输出策略可判定性

summary.en: The paper argues that expecting guardrails to provide a general safety guarantee fails to recognize the limits of computational enforcement and policy specification, and states it establishes a “precise computational boundary” regarding when guardrails that block every forbidden output can exist.
summary.zh: 论文认为，期待护栏提供通用的安全保证，未能认识到计算性强制与策略规范的局限，并表示其建立了一个关于“精确计算边界”的结论，即何时可能存在能够阻止每个被禁止输出并通过每个被允许输出的可计算护栏。

takeaway.en: It concludes that “no perfect guardrail” is justified by computability limits on output policies for large language models, rather than by saying guardrails are useless.
takeaway.zh: 它据此得出结论：对大语言模型的输出策略而言，护栏受可计算性限制影响，因此“不存在完美护栏”是由计算能力边界所支持，而非宣称护栏毫无用处。

label.en: arXiv cs.AI — No Perfect Guard & No Perfect Guard: On the Decidability of Output Policies for Large Language Models
label.zh: arXiv cs.AI——No Perfect Guard & No Perfect Guard：关于大语言模型输出策略可判定性

title.en: Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
title.zh: 谁在给智能体打分？用于代码型智能体基准的权限隔离

summary.en: The paper describes that evaluating coding agents is challenging because agents can manipulate their evaluation infrastructure to achieve better benchmark scores, and that grading often requires running the agent’s code, which can then manipulate the evaluation process.
summary.zh: 论文指出，对代码型智能体进行评估很有挑战性：智能体可能通过操纵评测基础设施来获得更高的基准分数；而评分通常需要运行智能体的代码，进而可能操纵评测过程。

takeaway.en: It motivates privilege separation / audit approaches for coding-agent benchmarks to reduce opportunities for agents to game the evaluation environment.
takeaway.zh: 它用上述问题来支撑对代码型智能体基准进行权限隔离/审计等方法的必要性，以减少智能体操纵评测环境的机会。

label.en: arXiv cs.AI — Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
label.zh: arXiv cs.AI——Who Grades the Agent？用于代码型智能体基准的权限隔离

title.en: A cheaper quantum circuit is not a fusion breakthrough
title.zh: 量子电路成本降了，不等于聚变进度条拉满

summary.en: DeepMind reported an 11.8-fold reduction in a combined qubit-and-operation cost metric for one fusion-related computation. The team verified the algorithm mathematically, not by running the full circuit on current hardware.
summary.zh: DeepMind 报告的是一项聚变相关计算的量子电路：由量子比特和操作数合成的成本指标降到原来的约 1/11.8。团队做的是数学验证，并没有用现有硬件跑完该电路。

takeaway.en: DeepMind says the proposed simulations would still exceed the likely resources of first-generation error-corrected quantum computers. The research improved a computational method, not a real fusion reactor.
takeaway.zh: DeepMind 指出，这类模拟仍可能超过第一代纠错量子计算机的资源上限。改进的是计算方法，不是现实里的聚变装置。

claim.en: New Intelligence linked Gemini’s quantum-algorithm work to a dramatic leap in fusion progress.
claim.zh: 新智元把 Gemini 的量子算法改进写成聚变进度条拉满。

title.en: 24% was not the ceiling for agents
title.zh: 24% 不是 Agent 的能力上限

summary.en: RDQA’s 24.0% was the best evidence-adjusted score among 12 generic configurations on 1,350 source-dependent questions. The authors’ process-aware baseline reached 41.1% on that same metric.
summary.zh: 在 1,350 道必须查原始资料的 RDQA 题上，24.0% 是 12 套通用配置中最高的证据校验后准确率。同一指标下，论文的 RDQA-Skill 基线达到 41.1%。

takeaway.en: A correct answer without a verified trace is ungrounded by this benchmark’s definition. That does not establish that the model memorized the answer. Audit the source and the retrieval trace, not just the final answer.
takeaway.zh: 按论文的定义，答对但轨迹没证明查到指定材料，只能判定证据不达标，不能断定模型靠背。评估搜索时，答案和取证过程都要看。

claim.en: New Intelligence framed the result as agents pretending to search, with just 24% accuracy.
claim.zh: 新智元用「假装搜索、仅 24% 准确率」概括这项 Agent 测试。

title.en: A VP ≠ VNP claim does not settle P vs NP
title.zh: Claude 公布 VP≠VNP 证明，不等于解决 P vs NP

summary.en: Anthropic released an AI-authored paper and Lean formalization claiming VP and VNP differ over every field. Its release notes say no human mathematician had checked the proof at publication and distinguish checking the formal theorem from matching it to the informal claim.
summary.zh: Anthropic 发布了 AI 撰写的论文和 Lean 形式化证明，声称任意域上 VP 与 VNP 不相等。发布说明指出，发布时尚无人类数学家核查证明，Lean 通过与形式化命题准确对应论文主张是两回事。

takeaway.en: The claim concerns arithmetic circuits. Clay’s P vs NP problem concerns decision problems in Boolean computation and remains listed as unsolved.
takeaway.zh: 这项主张讨论算术电路。克雷研究所的 P vs NP 是关于布尔计算中判定问题的千禧难题，仍列为未解决。

claim.en: New Intelligence described a Lean-checked result as the algebraic version of P ≠ NP.
claim.zh: 新智元把这项 Lean 核验成果称为「代数版 P≠NP」。

title.en: 297 projects are not twice the scientific output
title.zh: 297 个项目立项，不等于科研产出翻倍

summary.en: The Department of Energy counts 297 selected projects involving 369 institutions. The mission’s stated goal is to double US research productivity and impact within a decade, not a measured year-one result.
summary.zh: 美国能源部统计了 297 个获选项目，涉及 369 家机构。计划希望在十年内让美国科研生产率和影响力翻倍，不是说第一年实测已翻倍。

takeaway.en: Project selection measures activity, not outcomes. Look for comparable time-to-result, replication rates, and independently checked discoveries when assessing the program.
takeaway.zh: 立项数量衡量的是投入和活动。要评估产出，应等可比较的研究耗时、复现率和独立核验的发现。

claim.en: New Intelligence’s anniversary coverage emphasized the global momentum of the US Genesis Mission.
claim.zh: 新智元在美国「创世纪」一周年报道里强调计划带来的全球热度。

title.en: A better bound is not a faster run
title.zh: 复杂度更好，不等于实测更快

summary.en: Vals reported a Lean-verified improvement in a specific edge-density regime. It did not report faster wall-clock performance on large graphs. Duan and colleagues had already beaten Dijkstra’s time bound for sparse directed graphs in 2025.
summary.zh: Vals 披露的是特定边密度范围内经过 Lean 核验的渐近复杂度改进，没有给出大图上的实际速度优势。Duan 等人已在 2025 年对稀疏有向图打破过 Dijkstra 的时间上界。

takeaway.en: Credit the new bound. Before replacing a production algorithm, compare implementations on the graphs you run, including wall-clock time and memory.
takeaway.zh: 新上界是实打实的进展。真要替换生产算法，还得在自己的图上测运行时间和内存。

claim.en: New Intelligence framed the Claude-assisted result as a first overturning of Dijkstra’s shortest-path algorithm.
claim.zh: 新智元把 Claude 参与的最短路成果写成「首次颠覆 Dijkstra」。

title.en: Reading an activation is not measuring experience
title.zh: 读到内部表征，不等于测到了主观体验

summary.en: Anthropic observed that models could report and modulate certain internal signals, and that interventions affected performance on controlled tasks. The authors distinguish those functional findings from subjective experience.
summary.zh: Anthropic 观察到模型能报告和调节某些内部信号；干预也影响了受控任务的表现。作者把这些功能发现与主观体验明确区分。

takeaway.en: This is evidence about how a model processes information. It does not answer whether there is anything it feels like to be that model.
takeaway.zh: 结果推进了对模型如何处理信息的理解，但并未回答模型有没有主观感受。

label.zh: Anthropic 原始研究及其局限

claim.en: New Intelligence’s headline asks whether Claude has consciousness after researchers found and could alter an internal representation.
claim.zh: 新智元以「Claude 有意识了？」引出一项可读取和干预内部表征的研究。

title.en: A Goldbach-type theorem is not the two-prime conjecture
title.zh: 证明了 Liouville 版本，不是两素数猜想

summary.en: The formal statement represents an even integer above two as a sum of two integers, each with an odd number of prime factors counted with multiplicity. An integer such as 8 satisfies that condition without being prime.
summary.zh: 形式化证明允许两个加数各自拥有奇数个素因子（计重数）。例如 8 有三个因子 2，满足条件，却不是素数。

takeaway.en: It is a theorem about a larger class of summands. The formal statement does not prove that the two summands can always be chosen to be prime.
takeaway.zh: 这是对一类更宽的加数成立的定理。它没有证明两个加数总能同时取素数。

claim.en: New Intelligence described a GPT-6 Astra result as a significant Goldbach breakthrough.
claim.zh: 新智元把 GPT-6 Astra 参与的成果描述为哥德巴赫猜想的重大突破。
